name: Incline Dumbbell Y-Raise
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a light dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Raise your arms forward and up in a Y shape, thumbs pointing up.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Use very light weights and keep your neck neutral.
